title: Add admin tooling to quarantine flaky prompt sets (reason codes + expiry)
author: Olivia Grant
description:
Context
We’ve seen a small but persistent set of prompt sets/suites drive flaky quality gate outcomes (false negatives / inconsistent deltas). During the internal beta we’ve been “fixing forward” by editing suites, but we need an explicit, auditable quarantine mechanism so oncall/Applied ML can temporarily remove known-bad suites from gating while we investigate.

This PR adds admin tooling + persisted quarantine state for prompt sets, including reason codes and optional expiration. Optimize/quality gates will consult this quarantine state and (by default) block runs that would otherwise claim required coverage.

What’s in this PR
- Admin API endpoints (RBAC-protected) to quarantine/unquarantine prompt sets:
  - POST /admin/evals/prompt-sets/:promptSetId/quarantine
  - POST /admin/evals/prompt-sets/:promptSetId/unquarantine
  - GET  /admin/evals/prompt-sets/:promptSetId (includes quarantine status)
- Quarantine metadata persisted in control plane:
  - reason_code (enum)
  - reason_detail (free text)
  - quarantined_by (actor)
  - quarantined_at
  - expires_at (optional)
  - linked_ticket (optional; SUP-/ENG-/INC- freeform string)
- Reason codes (v1):
  - FLAKE_HIGH (flake score above threshold)
  - INFRA_INSTABILITY (GPU scarcity / timeouts / region issues)
  - DATA_DRIFT (prompt distribution changed)
  - GOLDEN_MISMATCH (goldens out of date)
  - POLICY_REMOVAL (privacy/compliance removal)
  - OTHER
- Gate behavior integration:
  - If a gate run requests a prompt set that is quarantined, the run transitions to FAILED with a structured failure reason:
    - failure_code=REQUIRED_PROMPT_SET_QUARANTINED
    - includes prompt_set_id + quarantine metadata snapshot
  - If a quarantined prompt set is non-required (optional coverage), we log + mark the run as DEGRADED_COVERAGE, but do not fail (policy-controlled; default: optional coverage only)
- Audit trail:
  - Emits audit log events: quality.prompt_set.quarantined and quality.prompt_set.unquarantined
  - Includes actor, reason_code, expires_at, and linked_ticket
- Operator tooling:
  - Adds rw-admin command:
    - rw-admin evals quarantine --prompt-set <id> --reason-code <code> --expires-in 72h --ticket SUP-18421 --detail "flake score > 0.35 in eu-west"
    - rw-admin evals unquarantine --prompt-set <id> --ticket ENG-3929
- Observability:
  - Metrics:
    - quality_gates_prompt_set_quarantined_total{reason_code}
    - quality_gates_prompt_set_blocked_total{failure_code}
    - quality_gates_prompt_set_degraded_coverage_total
  - Structured logs on gate planning: includes quarantined prompt set ids and whether they were required/optional

Why block (fail closed) on required prompt sets?
We don’t want a gate run to “pass” while silently skipping required coverage. The failure message surfaces the quarantine metadata and directs users to either (a) unquarantine after fix, (b) update gating policy to use a substitute set, or (c) request a time-bound override for the config change.

Testing
- Unit tests:
  - reason_code validation + expires_at parsing
  - RBAC check enforcement on admin endpoints
  - gate planner behavior for required vs optional suites
- Integration tests:
  - quarantine -> trigger gate -> expect FAILED with REQUIRED_PROMPT_SET_QUARANTINED
  - quarantine optional -> run -> expect DEGRADED_COVERAGE + pass/fail from metrics

Rollout / flags
- Feature flag: quality_gates.prompt_set_quarantine_enforcement
  - staging: ON
  - prod: ON (admin endpoints are still RBAC-gated; enforcement is safe because quarantine defaults to false for all sets)

Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Console UI surfacing quarantine status inline in gate results (DES-611 / ENG-3925)
- Auto-quarantine suggestions when flake_score crosses threshold for N consecutive runs (ENG-3929)

Notes
This was motivated by SUP-18421 (false positive gate block) where a single prompt set exhibited high variance; we need a clear mechanism to quarantine while calibrating thresholds and fixing goldens.

quality-gates: consult quarantine state during planning + structured failure codes
cli: add rw-admin evals quarantine/unquarantine commands
obs: add metrics + logs for quarantine blocks/degraded coverage
tests: unit + integration coverage for quarantine flows

conversation: Selene Huang: For optional coverage, can we make the policy explicit rather than hardcoded? I’m worried we’ll accidentally treat a previously-required set as optional later.

Olivia Grant (author): Good call. I updated gate_planner to consult the existing prompt set manifest (required=true/false) and to treat quarantine as FAIL only when required=true. Added an integration test that fails if required status is missing/unknown (fail closed).
Allison Grant: Please add a metric we can alert on for sudden spikes in REQUIRED_PROMPT_SET_QUARANTINED, otherwise we’ll just see “gate fail rate up” without an obvious cause.

Olivia Grant (author): Added quality_gates_prompt_set_blocked_total{failure_code} and wired failure_code=REQUIRED_PROMPT_SET_QUARANTINED. Also added structured log field quarantined_prompt_sets_required_count so we can correlate quickly.
Connor O'Brien: Any risk that oncall uses this as a permanent crutch? Can we require expires_at unless POLICY_REMOVAL?

Olivia Grant (author): I added validation: expires_at is optional, but the CLI warns (and requires --force) if no expiry is provided and reason_code != POLICY_REMOVAL. The API records linked_ticket for auditing.
Dylan Brooks: CLI output should be copy/paste friendly for incident channels. Can you include the quarantine summary + next steps?
Olivia Grant (author): Updated rw-admin to print a one-liner summary including prompt_set_id, reason_code, expires_at, and the exact failure_code users will see in Console.
Karthik Iyer: Approving. This is the missing operational knob for the beta—please ensure the audit event includes the ticket id; we’ll need it for postmortems.
Olivia Grant (author): Included linked_ticket in audit payload + added unit test for serialization.
